description: This file defines a SpeechBubble class with methods for rendering speech bubbles on a canvas, including text formatting, tail drawing, and boundary calculations. It also includes utility classes and functions for vector math, bezier curves, and bounds management.

classes.name: SpeechBubble
classes.description: Main class for rendering speech bubbles with text, tail, and panel attributes.

classes.name: SpeechBubble.Vector
classes.description: Represents a 2D vector with methods for addition, subtraction, scaling, and magnitude.

classes.name: SpeechBubble.Bounds
classes.description: Defines rectangular bounds with methods for movement, resizing, and boundary checks.

classes.name: SpeechBubble.BezierCurve
classes.description: Handles drawing and calculating points along a Bezier curve for tail rendering.

methods.name: SpeechBubble.prototype.setTargetPos
methods.description: Sets the target position for the speech bubble tail.

methods.name: SpeechBubble.prototype.draw
methods.description: Renders the speech bubble, including panel, tail, and text.

methods.name: SpeechBubble.prototype.formatText
methods.description: Formats input text into lines that fit within the bubble, considering overflow settings.

methods.name: SpeechBubble.prototype.getSafeSpace
methods.description: Returns the area within the bubble where text can safely be rendered.

methods.name: SpeechBubble.prototype.drawText
methods.description: Draws formatted text lines inside the bubble.

methods.name: SpeechBubble.prototype.drawPanelWall
methods.description: Draws a wall segment of the panel, including tail if necessary.

methods.name: SpeechBubble.prototype.drawTail
methods.description: Draws the tail of the speech bubble, either straight or curved.

methods.name: SpeechBubble.prototype.drawPanelCorners
methods.description: Draws rounded corners of the panel.

methods.name: SpeechBubble.prototype.getTailLocation
methods.description: Calculates the position and side of the tail based on target position.

methods.name: SpeechBubble.prototype.drawDebug
methods.description: Draws debug visuals for the bubble's safe space and tail location.

methods.name: SpeechBubble.prototype.debugSquare
methods.description: Draws a small square at a point for debugging.

methods.name: SpeechBubble.BezierCurve.prototype.addPoint
methods.description: Adds a control point to the Bezier curve.

methods.name: SpeechBubble.BezierCurve.prototype.draw
methods.description: Draws the Bezier curve based on control points.

methods.name: SpeechBubble.BezierCurve.prototype.getPoint
methods.description: Calculates a point on the Bezier curve for a parameter t.
